note: Offline game, synthetic grids (seeds 0..7), the challenge's real spec.

rungs.label: Naive scheduler
rungs.change: First legal zone (alphabetical), fastest machine, start as soon as quota allows, run straight through.

rungs.label: + where and which machine
rungs.change: Each job goes to the legal zone and machine with the lowest forecast PUE x g/kWh x kW.

rungs.label: + when to start
rungs.change: Also moves each job's start to the cleanest forecast window that still meets the deadline.

rungs.label: + stop through dirty hours
rungs.change: The full planner: a block of hours per job, run in its cleanest hours, stopped in the others.
